errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

ScheduleNotFound.title: No vesting stream found
ScheduleNotFound.explanation: We couldn't find a vesting stream for this address.
ScheduleNotFound.action: Double-check the address, and confirm you're connected with the wallet the stream was created for. If you expect a stream here, ask your sponsor to create one.

CliffNotReached.title: Your cliff date hasn't arrived yet
CliffNotReached.explanation: Tokens unlock in a single release once the cliff date passes.
CliffNotReached.action: Nothing to do right now — check the cliff date on your stream and come back then. Tokens drip linearly from that point onwards.

InvalidDuration.title: The durations don't line up
InvalidDuration.explanation: The total duration must be longer than the cliff duration.
InvalidDuration.action: Increase the total duration or shorten the cliff, so there's time left after the cliff for tokens to drip.

InvalidRate.title: That rate won't work
InvalidRate.explanation: The token rate must be a whole number greater than zero.
InvalidRate.action: Enter a rate of at least 1 token per ledger.

DepositOverflow.title: That deposit is too large
DepositOverflow.explanation: Rate multiplied by duration would exceed the maximum amount the contract can track.
DepositOverflow.action: Reduce the rate, shorten the duration, or both, so the total deposit stays within the allowed limit.

ScheduleAlreadyExists.title: A stream already exists for this recipient
ScheduleAlreadyExists.explanation: Each recipient address can only have one active vesting stream at a time.
ScheduleAlreadyExists.action: Cancel the existing stream first, or use a different recipient address.

NothingToClaim.title: You've already claimed all available tokens
NothingToClaim.explanation: Your claimable balance is 0 for this ledger. Tokens accrue as the network produces new ledgers.
NothingToClaim.action: Check back soon for more — there's nothing to do right now.

StreamNotExpired.title: This stream hasn't finished yet
StreamNotExpired.explanation: This action is only available once the stream has reached its end date.
StreamNotExpired.action: Wait until the stream's end date has passed, then try again.

TransferFailed.title: The transfer failed
TransferFailed.explanation: The token transfer couldn't be completed. Your tokens are safe — nothing was moved.
TransferFailed.action: Please try again in a moment. If it keeps failing, check that your account isn't frozen and has enough balance.

DrainDelayNotExpired.title: It's too early to recover unclaimed tokens
DrainDelayNotExpired.explanation: There's a mandatory waiting period after a stream ends before unclaimed tokens can be recovered by the sponsor.
DrainDelayNotExpired.action: Wait for the full delay period after the end date, then try again.

InvalidRecipient.title: That recipient address won't work
InvalidRecipient.explanation: The sponsor and the recipient must be different addresses.
InvalidRecipient.action: Enter a recipient address that isn't your own wallet.

InvalidCliffDuration.title: The cliff duration isn't valid
InvalidCliffDuration.explanation: The cliff duration must be greater than zero — a stream needs a lock-up period before anything unlocks.
InvalidCliffDuration.action: Enter a cliff duration of at least 1 ledger.

AlreadyInitialized.title: This contract is already set up
AlreadyInitialized.explanation: Initialisation can only happen once, right after deployment.
AlreadyInitialized.action: No action needed — the contract is ready to use.

RecipientNotAllowed.title: That recipient isn't allowed
RecipientNotAllowed.explanation: This deployment only streams to a configured list of approved recipient addresses.
RecipientNotAllowed.action: Ask the stream owner to add this address to the allowlist, or use a different recipient.

StreamPaused.title: This stream is paused
StreamPaused.explanation: The sponsor has temporarily paused this stream, so claims are disabled.
StreamPaused.action: Nothing to do — ask the sponsor to resume the stream when you're ready to claim again.

BatchTooLarge.title: Too many streams in one go
BatchTooLarge.explanation: Batch creation is limited to 20 streams per transaction to keep it affordable and reliable.
BatchTooLarge.action: Split your list into smaller batches of 20 or fewer and submit again.

RateTooLow.title: That rate is below the minimum
RateTooLow.explanation: Rate multiplied by total duration falls under the minimum deposit this contract accepts.
RateTooLow.action: Increase the rate, lengthen the duration, or both, so the total deposit meets the minimum.

NotInitialized.title: This contract isn't ready yet
NotInitialized.explanation: The contract hasn't been initialised yet, so it can't accept streams or claims.
NotInitialized.action: This is an operator issue — please contact support if it persists.

InvalidSegments.title: The rate segments aren't valid
InvalidSegments.explanation: Variable-rate streams need at least one segment, in order, each with a rate greater than zero.
InvalidSegments.action: Check that your segments are listed in chronological order and that every rate is greater than zero.

MetadataTooLong.title: That description is too long
MetadataTooLong.explanation: Stream metadata is limited to 256 bytes.
MetadataTooLong.action: Shorten the description and try again.

Unauthorized.title: You're not allowed to do that
Unauthorized.explanation: Only the contract administrator or the original sponsor can perform this action.
Unauthorized.action: If you started this stream, check that you're connected with the same wallet. Otherwise, ask the sponsor to make the change.

DepositBelowMinimum.title: The deposit is below the minimum
DepositBelowMinimum.explanation: The total deposit doesn't reach the minimum amount this contract accepts.
DepositBelowMinimum.action: Increase the rate, lengthen the duration, or both, so the total deposit meets the minimum.

StreamAlreadyPaused.title: This stream is already paused
StreamAlreadyPaused.explanation: You can only pause a stream that isn't already paused.
StreamAlreadyPaused.action: No action needed — the stream is already paused.

StreamNotPaused.title: This stream isn't paused
StreamNotPaused.explanation: You can only resume a stream that's currently paused.
StreamNotPaused.action: No action needed — the stream is already running.

VersionOverflow.title: The stream has reached its version limit
VersionOverflow.explanation: This stream has been updated more times than the contract can track.
VersionOverflow.action: Please contact support — the stream needs manual attention before it can be changed again.

ClawbackNotSupported.title: This token doesn't support clawback
ClawbackNotSupported.explanation: Clawback requires the token issuer to have enabled it. Most tokens don't support it.
ClawbackNotSupported.action: Cancel the stream instead to recover the unspent deposit — that works with any standard token.

Unexpected.title: Something unexpected happened
Unexpected.explanation: We hit an error we don't recognise while processing your request.
Unexpected.action: Try again in a moment. If this keeps happening, refresh the page or contact support.
